{{Infobox auto}}
The '''cleaver''' is a knife-like sword with [[Slaughter]] I and Looting II, sold by the [[Cook|cook]]. Its internal name is "butcher knife". It deals {{Hp|6}} damage at an attack speed of 1.6 and has 1500 durability, but it shortens the wielder's reach by 1 block.

== Obtaining ==
=== Trading ===
A level 4 cook sells it for one [[Obol|obol]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/butcher/4/butcher_knife.json}}</ref>

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
It deals 6 damage at attack speed 1.6 with 1500 durability, but its attack reach is 1 block shorter than normal. It is repaired with iron ingots.

== History ==
